meta.title: Albert Alexander passage (example)
meta.notes: Example of the two-layer format. Timing estimated at about 150 wpm with slower dramatic lines.

assumptions: Winter dusk, dark windows, one lamp at the entrance: period-plausible choices, not from the script.
Iron beds, mostly empty ward, a pendulum wall clock: plausible for a 1940s British hospital, check against reference photos.
The bed chart with a flat, high temperature line and the fly on the rail are invented illustrations.
The lab flask scene in the final shot is an assumed next scene, shown only to demonstrate a transition.

shots.literal: Wide exterior of an Oxford hospital on a cold winter evening. Windows are dark and a single lamp is lit by the entrance. Camera pushes slowly toward the entrance.
shots.ambient_visual: Fog drifts across the lamp. One window light flickers off.

transition_out.audio_bridge: Wind softens into a room hum

shots.narration: A police officer named Albert Alexander
shots.literal: Interior close-up of a British police helmet and tunic hung on a bedside hook. Camera tilts down toward the bed. His face is not shown yet.
shots.ambient_visual: The tunic hem sways slightly in a draft. Dust turns in the lamp beam.
shots.ambient_audio: A clock begins ticking, quietly, under the room hum

shots.narration: lies in a hospital in Oxford.
shots.literal: Wide of the ward: two rows of iron beds, most empty, one occupied under the lamp. Camera pulls back from the occupied bed to reveal the whole ward.
shots.ambient_visual: A curtain on the far side moves in the draft. A wall clock is visible, pendulum swinging.
shots.ambient_audio: Ticking continues. Bed springs creak once.

transition_out.audio_bridge: Ticking continues under a new shot

shots.literal: Medium close-up of Alexander's face on the pillow, stylized and not graphic. Swollen patches appear across his cheek and jaw one at a time. He breathes shallowly. Camera pushes in slowly.
shots.ambient_visual: His breath lifts the edge of the sheet in small, uneven movements. The lamp flickers once.
shots.ambient_audio: Shallow, laboured breathing under the ticking

shots.narration: One eye has already been removed.
shots.literal: Tight on the dressing over one eye, then a cut to the bed chart at the foot of the bed where a temperature line stays high. Hard cut to black on the last beat.
shots.ambient_visual: A fly lands on the chart rail. The temperature line does not move.
shots.ambient_audio: Ticking gets slightly louder, then cuts out entirely at the black

transition_out.out_frame: Black. Last visible image: the bed chart with a fly on its rail.
transition_out.in_frame: Close-up of a glass flask on a lab bench, pale liquid dripping slowly from a funnel into it.
transition_out.bridge: No visual link. A drip sound starts during the black at the same tempo as the clock that was cut out.
transition_out.audio_bridge: About 1 second of silence after the clock stops, then a single drip, then drips at the clock's rhythm; picture cuts in on the second drip.

shots.literal: Close-up of a glass flask on a lab bench. Pale liquid drips slowly from a funnel into it. Camera holds, then pans left to a row of identical flasks.
shots.ambient_visual: Condensation beads on the glass. Light shifts slowly across the bench.
shots.ambient_audio: Slow drips at the rhythm of the earlier clock
